title: Hat of the Sharp Caster

sources.title: Sharp Caster
markers: | summary = '''Sharp Caster''' is a passive feature that rerolls low damage die, once.

summary: Reroll a 1 or 2 on a spell damage die once.

fields.Actual scope: The game also rerolls damage from spells without an attack roll. It does not reroll Booming Blade’s Thunder damage, but can reroll the elemental rider from Ring of Elemental Infusion.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
